def pow5 (x : Std.U32) : Result Std.U32 := do

  let i ← m31_mul square square

    Visibility: public -/
def apply_round
  (state : Array Std.U32 16#usize) (round : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 16#usize)
  := do
  if round < 4#usize
  then let a ← Array.index_usize EXTERNAL_INITIAL round
       full_round state a
  else
    if round < 18#usize
    then
      let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub round 4#usize)
      let i1 ← Array.index_usize INTERNAL i
      internal_round state i1 INTERNAL_SHIFTS
    else
      let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize)
      let a ← Array.index_usize EXTERNAL_FINAL i
      full_round state a

/-- [aspis_r0_poseidon_copy::perm_rounds]: loop 0:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 215:4-219:5
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop]
def perm_rounds_loop
  (rounds : Array (Array Std.U32 16#usize) 11#usize)
  (state : Array Std.U32 16#usize) (k : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array (Array Std.U32 16#usize) 11#usize)
  := do
  if k < 11#usize
  then
    let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k)
    let a ← apply_round state i
    let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k)
    let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i1 1#usize)
    let state1 ← apply_round a i2
    let a1 ← Array.update rounds k state1
    let k1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add k 1#usize)
    perm_rounds_loop a1 state1 k1
  else ok rounds
partial_fixpoint

/-- [aspis_r0_poseidon_copy::perm_rounds]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 210:0-221:1
    Visibility: public -/
def perm_rounds
  (pre : Array Std.U32 16#usize) (absorb : Array Std.U32 16#usize) :
  Result (Array (Array Std.U32 16#usize) 11#usize)
  := do
  let a := Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32
  let rounds := Array.repeat 11#usize a
  let a1 ← Array.index_usize EXTERNAL_INITIAL 0#usize
  let a2 ← Array.index_usize EXTERNAL_INITIAL 1#usize
  let state ← leading_pair pre absorb a1 a2
  let a3 ← Array.update rounds 0#usize state
  perm_rounds_loop a3 state 1#usize

end R0PoseidonCopy
